name: Shandong Hi-Speed Road&Bridge Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Hi-Speed Road&Bridge Group Co., Ltd. engages in the contracting business in China and internationally. The company involved in the general contracting for highways, municipal construction, buildings, water conservancy and hydropower, power construction, port and shipping, railways, and electromechanical construction. It also engages in professional construction contracting business for roadbeds, pavements, bridges, tunnels, and steel structures; and engineering survey, mapping, design, supervision, and consulting business. The company was formerly known as Shandong Hi-Speed Road & Bridge Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shandong Hi-Speed Road&Bridge Group Co., Ltd. in January 2021.…
